notes: Synthetic shape fixture derived from the live OpenCode ACP smoke observation; it is not a retained raw trace.
The six session updates preserve one available-commands update, three thought chunks, one assistant-message chunk, and one usage update.
All identifiers, text, token counts, and the permitted fixture path are fixed placeholders.

ACP has no message end, so the translator closes output itself: answer text after an untagged thought completes that thought block (a later thought opens the next block's item), and the completed prompt response completes the turn's still-open text, thought and plan items before the turn terminal.
